title: Senior Product Manager, Partner Insights & Systems Integration
jd_text: Cohesity is a leader in AI-powered data security and management. Aided by an extensive ecosystem of partners, Cohesity makes it easy to secure, protect, manage, and get value from data — across the data center, edge, and cloud. Cohesity helps organizations defend against cybersecurity threats with comprehensive data security and management capabilities, including immutable backup snapshots, AI-based threat detection, monitoring for malicious behavior, and rapid recovery at scale. We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design. Join us on our mission to shape the future of our industry. This is a SaaS product management role at the center of Cohesity's partner ecosystem. The Senior Product Manager, Partner Insights & Systems Integration owns the full arc from partner conversation to shipped capability: sitting directly with partners and other stakeholders to demo capabilities, run listening sessions, and draw out real requirements; translating that voice-of-partner input into structured product and system requirements; and then partnering with Enterprise Technology to design, build, integrate, and validate the systems that deliver on those requirements — including hands-on user acceptance testing before go-live. The ideal candidate combines outbound product management experience from an enterprise SaaS company with genuine ease in front of partners and customers, strong competitive and market analysis instincts, and enough fluency in how partner business actually flows to know what a well-functioning system should look like. Experience with Partner Relationship Management (PRM) systems is required . This person is the connective tissue between what partners tell us and what Enterprise Technology builds — equally credible in a partner advisory board and in a systems design review. HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE: Partner Listening & Requirements Gathering Sit directly with partners and other stakeholders — in listening sessions, demos, advisory boards, and 1:1 conversations — to gather feedback and probe for the real requirement behind the request. Own multi-channel partner feedback infrastructure (NPS, transactional surveys, always-on sentiment, qualitative interviews, field-gathered insight from channel managers) across distributors, VARs, MSPs, SIs, and ISVs. Convert qualitative and quantitative partner feedback into clear, prioritized, testable requirements that Enterprise Technology can design against. Close the loop with partners: communicate how their feedback shaped program and system decisions, building trust in the listening process. Facilitate structured feedback mechanisms that give partner voices a formal channel to Cohesity leadership. Product Management & Competitive Market Analysis Bring outbound product management discipline from an enterprise SaaS background — market sizing, competitive teardown, positioning input, and voice-of-partner synthesis — to the partner systems roadmap. Continuously track the competitive landscape for partner programs, PRM platforms, and partner portal experiences; bring market insight to bear on requirements and prioritization. Own and prioritize the partner-facing product/requirements backlog, balancing partner-voiced needs against Enterprise Technology capacity and business impact. Apply knowledge of how partner and channel business actually flows — deal registration, MDF/rebate claims, tiering, onboarding — to judge whether a proposed system design will actually work in the field. Build the business case (cost/benefit, adoption impact) for proposed product and system changes and present it to Partner Programs and Enterprise Technology leadership. Enterprise Technology & Systems Integration Serve as the primary liaison between the Partner Programs team, Business Stakeholders, and Enterprise Technology, translating approved program requirements into system and integration specifications. Partner with Business Stakeholders & Enterprise Technology on the systemic integration of program design into core systems — CRM/SFDC, partner portal, deal registration, automated workflow, reporting, and analytics platforms. Act as subject-matter expert on how channel systems interconnect (e.g., SFDC-to-partner-portal integration, automated process flows between systems) and troubleshoot systemic issues in partnership with global system administrators. Test and validate that new or modified systems and integrations accurately reflect program requirements before go-live, and own defect triage during rollout. Identify opportunities to automate manual, error-prone channel processes in collaboration with Enterprise Technology. Project Management & User Acceptance Testing Own the end-to-end project plan for translating each approved requirement into a live, integrated system capability — scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and resourcing. Design and lead user acceptance testing: write UAT plans and test scripts, recruit and coordinate partner and stakeholder testers, run test cycles, and own defect triage and sign-off before launch. Lead cross-functional project teams (Partner Programs, Enterprise Technology, Sales Ops, Channel, Communications, Finance) through structured governance, status reporting, and issue escalation. Track and report project-level progress, risks, and blockers to leadership; drive resolution of field/partner efficiency blockers tied to system or process gaps. Build and maintain project artifacts (project plans, RAID logs, UAT plans, rollout/cutover plans) using standard PM tooling. Build and maintain partner sentiment, seller engagement, and system-performance dashboards, and publish a regular report that connects partner feedback to product and system outcomes. WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING: 5+ years of experience in product management at an enterprise SaaS company, ideally with outbound product management responsibilities (market/competitive analysis, positioning input, customer- or partner-facing requirements gathering). Demonstrated ease and credibility sitting directly with partners, customers, or other external stakeholders to demo capabilities, run discovery conversations, and gather requirements. Hands-on experience with Partner Relationship Management (PRM) systems and channel/partner systems and processes: Salesforce (SFDC), partner portals, deal registration, and automated business process flows between systems. Working proficiency in Salesforce, including building and running reports and dashboards, creating and managing list views, and navigating the partner/customer account model; familiarity with PRM tools and content management within Salesforce or equivalent CRM (Salesforce preferred). Proven experience designing and executing user acceptance testing for enterprise systems, including test planning, stakeholder coordination, and defect triage through go-live . Proven project management skills, including scoping, planning, risk management, and cross-functional execution; PMP, PgMP , or Agile certification a plus . Demonstrated ability to partner with Enterprise Technology/IT teams to translate business requirements into system specifications and integration designs. Strong competitive and market analysis skills, with the judgment to translate market insight into product requirements. Strong analytical skills — comfortable collecting and interpreting data to find root causes and quantify process and program performance. Excellent organizational and time-management skills; able to manage multiple concurrent integration projects with competing priorities. Experience with project and analytics tooling such as Smartsheet, Jira, Microsoft Project, Tableau, or Power BI. Experience with partner advisory councils or boards, and partner feedback collection (NPS, surveys, sentiment programs) at scale. Bachelor's degree required , MBA preferred or equivalent experience. #LI-PR1 Disclosure Pursuant to Applicable State Equal Pay Transparency Laws - This position has a starting pay range as listed below. title: Staff Technical Program Manager, PSA Ops
jd_text: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. Why This Role: We are building world class, cutting edge experiences for collectors of all levels of experience. This role will have a direct impact on PSA Ops, the core software that powers PSA’s grading operations , in a business experiencing tremendous growth and record demand. You’ll help solve the unique technology and operational challenges that come with scaling at this level, where massive volume, complexity, and customer expectations create an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact. We are looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager who is practical, ambitious, and empathetic, with the ability to understand complex domains and drive teams toward exceptional outcomes. You’ll lead strategic, cross-functional programs from inception through delivery, partnering with engineering, product, design, and operations to align priorities, manage dependencies, and drive execution. Your work will have impact beyond the teams you support, directly influencing PSA’s ability to scale its operations and support the continued growth of the business. You’ll work from our Santa Ana or Jersey City office. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process. What You’ll Do: Collaboratively partner with other teams (Engineering, Design, Product, Business stakeholders, etc.) in the product development lifecycle to shape and prioritize product plans that solve customer problems in ways that deliver on company goals Focus on the most mission critical, high priority initiatives with a focus on business and technology objectives Provide best-in-class communications about project inception, milestones, and deliverables to stakeholders Develop and run training and educational programs to help transform organizational practices. Design and share processes and documents that provide maximum autonomy for development teams while maintaining a level of standardization that allows the company to scale. Combine superior communication skills with the analytical horsepower to break down complex, ambiguous problems and possess a strong will to be resourceful and get stuff done Solve problems with a focus on automation and process improvement, creating efficiencies as you work Contribute to the strategic roadmap prioritization processes with key stakeholders and deliver success management with multiple stakeholders Support our developer operations environment so we can continue to create new businesses and migrate existing ones, scaling our businesses across the globe to new heights Understand the customer and advocate for them Who You Are: 8+ years of product management and/or technical program management experience in a modern product or engineering organization operating in an agile environment. Preferred: Experience working on hardware, logistics, manufacturing, or other operationally intensive products and/or software programs. Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and tools such as Jira or other work management software. Depth in experience of technical program management practices including coordinating dependencies across teams, reporting on milestones, outcomes, and blockers, and leading successful releases/deployments across complex initiatives Proven ability to leverage AI tools such as Claude Cowork, Glean or similar technologies in day-to-day work to increase efficiency, accelerate execution, and improve outcomes. Strategic, highly collaborative leader who can rally teams around shared goals, navigate ambiguity and competing priorities, and drive measurable customer and business impact. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Salary Range: The salary range for this position is $151,341 –$220,480. Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, prior experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details. title: Product Manager, Merchant Payments & Integration
jd_text: Truemed helps people take control of their health by unlocking pre-tax HSA/FSA dollars for preventive care. We are the payments infrastructure that connects health and wellness merchants to billions of dollars in tax-advantaged consumer spending — powering seamless HSA/FSA transactions at checkout across Shopify storefronts, direct integrations, and emerging platforms. The Merchant Payments & Integration team is the engine behind how merchants go live with Truemed and how they stay live. As Product Manager for this team, you will own the full merchant journey: from first API call to first sale, through ongoing payment operations, revenue reconciliation, and platform ecosystem growth. You will work with a technical engineering team to build the developer experience, payment infrastructure, and merchant-facing tooling that let our partners run their businesses with confidence. We're looking for someone who is technical enough to speak credibly with engineers and merchants' dev teams, but who finds their edge in customer empathy and clear communication — someone who can translate a messy integration problem into a crisp spec, and a merchant's operational pain into a well-scoped product initiative. Payments experience is a bonus; the ability to quickly learn domain language and build trust with technical stakeholders is essential. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Own the end-to-end merchant experience: from developer onboarding and API integration through payment operations, revenue reconciliation, dispute management, and merchant dashboards - Own the developer platform roadmap: API design, documentation, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that reduce time-to-first-sale - Partner with engineering to design and ship platform integrations (Shopify, direct API, and emerging channels) - Serve as the voice of the merchant — synthesizing feedback from sales, merchant support, and direct merchant conversations into a prioritized roadmap - Define success metrics for merchant health (time to first sale, NRR, merchant NPS) and instrument the systems needed to track them - Navigate the intersection of payments infrastructure and compliance requirements, translating regulatory constraints into implementable product decisions - Drive cross-functional alignment across sales, customer support, and engineering to ensure smooth merchant launches and ongoing partner success WHO YOU ARE - Developer or merchant-facing experience: 3–5 years in product management, solutions engineering, developer relations, or a technical customer-facing role. You've sat across from a developer trying to integrate something you built, and you've felt the friction. - API fluency: You've worked on or with REST APIs. You understand webhooks, auth patterns, error handling, and what good API documentation looks like. You can participate meaningfully in API design conversations. - Operator mindset: You think about what merchants need to run their business — reconciliation, reporting, dispute resolution — not just what gets them to first sale. You understand that retention is a product problem. - Communication as a superpower: You're the person who can take a complex technical concept and make it immediately clear to a non-technical merchant or executive. You write with precision. You run meetings that end with decisions. - Bias for action: You default to shipping something and learning, not waiting for perfect specs. You've shipped a meaningful v0 in under two weeks and know what it takes to do it again. - AI-fluent: You use LLMs to move faster — drafting specs, analyzing feedback, summarizing research — and you think about how AI can improve the products you build. BONUS (NOT REQUIRED) - Experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure (merchant acquiring, money movement, reconciliation systems) - Familiarity with Shopify's platform ecosystem (apps, checkout extensions, payment customizations) - Experience at a company that sells to developers or technical buyers (Stripe, Twilio, Plaid, Affirm, etc.) ABOUT TRUEMED Our mission is to reverse chronic illness back to 1970s levels and make Americans healthy again. We will do this by shifting hundreds of billions of dollars away from our current broken healthcare system, and towards effective lifestyle interventions and prevention. Today's healthcare system spends less than 3% of the $4.3T in annual spending on prevention. This has to change. Today, 95% of all medical costs go to treating illness. Our goal is to empower people to invest in healthy habits today rather than treating illness in the future. Truemed enables patients to use pretax HSA/FSA funds to buy healthy food, exercise equipment, and supplements. We support brands like Peloton, Eight Sleep, Momentous, and hundreds of others. We're building the infrastructure that allows health and wellness merchants to accept the $150+ billion tied up in HSA and FSA accounts. COMP AND BENEFITS - Comp and equity in the top decile for Series A startups - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer sponsored HSA contributions - 401(k) - Unlimited PTO - Based in San Francisco, Los Angeles, or Austin - Coworking stipend - L&D Stipend - 2x/year company offsites and 2x/year team offsite

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Platform (Web3)
jd_text: About the company Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced user, Trust Wallet makes it easier, safer, and more convenient to explore Web3, securely access dApps, manage your crypto, and buy and sell digital assets, all in one place. Job Scope: - Own the data platform roadmap - Define and deliver the product roadmap for our data platform — covering data ingestion, on-chain data parsing, metrics frameworks, data-as-a-service, and data asset management — turning scattered data capabilities into reusable platform products. - Build on-chain data capabilities - Lead multi-chain data ingestion and parsing (EVM, Solana, Bitcoin, Cosmos, etc.). Define standardized parsing logic for transactions, transfers, contract calls, and DeFi interactions. Drive the buildout of address labels, protocol labels, and transaction attribution. - Own token and market data - Own the selection and governance of token metadata, pricing, and liquidity data sources. Establish source priority, fallback, and cross-validation mechanisms across CEX, DEX, third-party aggregators, and in-house indexers. Be accountable for data accuracy, coverage, and latency. - Serve downstream consumers - Partner with business, growth, risk, and BI teams to package data capabilities into APIs, datasets, and self-serve analytics tools that cut the cost of getting answers. - Data quality and governance - Build monitoring, metric definition management, and incident response processes. Eliminate the "same metric, five definitions" problem. - Cross-functional execution - Work closely with data engineering, backend, algorithm, and BI teams on requirement breakdown, prioritization, and delivery. Requirements: - 5-8 years in product management, including 3+ years on data platforms, data infrastructure, or internal data products - Hands-on Web3 experience (wallet, exchange, L1/L2, data provider, DeFi protocol) with real understanding of the business and user behavior - Practical knowledge of on-chain data: blocks, transactions, event logs, internal transactions, and the differences between UTXO and account models; familiarity with the data structures and parsing challenges of major chains - Familiarity with the token data landscape — the strengths, limitations, and appropriate use cases of CoinGecko, CMC, Chainlink oracles, DEX pool pricing, and similar sources - Solid grasp of data warehouse layering (ODS/DWD/DWS/ADS), metrics frameworks, and event tracking design - Able to read and write SQL; can pull and validate data independently Nice to Have - Built a data platform from zero to one - Experience with Dune, The Graph, Nansen, Covalent, Etherscan APIs, or similar tooling - Working knowledge of Flink, Spark, ClickHouse, or Airflow — enough to hold a technical design discussion with engineers - Experience commercializing data products or running external data services ADDITIONAL INFORMATION This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based. WHY WORK AT TRUST WALLET? - Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow. - Excellent learning and career development opportunities. - Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless. - Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects. - Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure. - Work fully remotely with flexible working hours. - Enjoy competitive salary and benefits. Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone. Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. *Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

title: Senior Product Manager, Agent Ecosystem
jd_text: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. How to be successful in this role: - 5+ years of product management experience, taking products from strategy through to shipped outcomes. - Experience shipping developer-facing or programmatic products (APIs, integrations, plugins, SDKs, or CLI tools), and comfort treating MCP, CLI, and plugins as product surfaces. - Technical fluency with APIs, authentication, and developer tools. Hands-on experience building with AI and agent tools, not just evaluating them. - Experience taking complex products or partnerships from strategy through launch. - Ability to connect ecosystem opportunities to customer problems and product outcomes. - Experience building relationships with technology platforms, AI companies, developer communities, or enterprise customers. - Experience leading cross-functional work across product, engineering, design, marketing, partnerships, legal, and go-to-market. - Strong written and verbal communication, and sound judgment in ambiguous environments. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. #LI-remote At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit. Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives. The Impact You'll Make Upside has established itself in fuel and scaled into grocery. Restaurant is the vertical with the most headroom and the least built — and this role owns it. As the Product Manager for the restaurant vertical, you'll operate like an entrepreneur inside a company that already has distribution, data, and a proven measurement engine: you decide which restaurant segments to win, what the wedge product is, and how the economics have to work for a restaurant operator to see real, provable profit. That means adapting Upside's core incrementality system to restaurant behavior, shaping the offer optimization models that price every promotion, and building the merchant-facing product that turns measured profit into a partner who renews and expands. Few PM roles come with this much ownership over a real business. What You'll Do - Own the strategy and roadmap for Upside's restaurant vertical on the merchant side — segment prioritization, feature requirements, and the path to scale. - Adapt Upside's core incrementality and measurement system to restaurant economics, where visit cadence, ticket size, margin structure, and promotion sensitivity all behave differently than fuel or grocery. - Partner with data science on restaurant offer optimization — pressure-testing model assumptions, surfacing limitations, and translating model behavior into terms a restaurant operator understands and trusts. - Drive transaction and profit growth for restaurant partners, and own the metrics that prove it. - Build the merchant-facing product experience that demonstrates value: measurement, reporting, onboarding, and the tools account teams use to make the case. - Partner with sales and account management to drive adoption and retention within restaurants, and act as the voice of the restaurant vertical in company-level forums. - Make build-vs-buy-vs-integrate calls on the POS, payments, and data integrations the vertical depends on. - Set and drive OKRs for the vertical, and lead cross-functionally — engineering, data science, design, sales, accounts, and marketing — without direct authority. title: Senior Product Manager, Document Management
jd_text: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As Senior Product Manager of Document Management, you will be responsible for agent-led content management, guiding customers through agentic workflows to generate and maintain documents and procedures tailored to their business. Today, this process is slow, manual, and often stressful for companies. These artifacts are foundational to how a company’s security program operates—requiring customers to interpret multiple compliance requirements, establish processes, and define how those processes run, all while ensuring they will meet auditor expectations. At the same time, when customers decide to take on a new framework, they need to quickly assess their program (controls, policies, procedures, documents) against those new requirements to understand the gaps and assess the body of work to implement that new framework. This is a manual, tedious process that many companies end up outsourcing to consultants. As Senior Product Manager for Document Management, you will work cross functionally to build an agentic solution to automate these gap assessments, helping customers more quickly achieve their security and business objectives by scaling to new frameworks faster. By guiding and automating the creation, editing, and management of content end-to-end, you will help customers dramatically shorten the path to audit readiness and scaling their compliance program, while building confidence that their processes and documentation are aligned to their business needs. What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager at Vanta: - Own the agentic document, policies, and procedure creation and editing workflows, as well as agentic gap assessments - Help customers evolve their security programs by building Agent workflows for surfacing recommendations and completing relevant actions - Deeply understand our customers and market, and translate their needs into clear Agent experiences that solve real compliance challenges - Partner with design and engineering to establish consistent interaction patterns—across chat, inline actions, and background automations—that make the Agent reliable, explainable, and safe - Deliver high-quality products that addresses key customer pain points and establishes Vanta’s leadership in AI powered GRC solutions - Help define and shape Vanta’s product team culture as we grow How to be successful in this role: - Have 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality SaaS/B2B and AI products - Have strong technical skills and experience shipping AI products, including writing and iterating on prompts, evaluating outputs, and driving systematic quality improvements - Possess a customer-focused mindset– proactively reach out to customers, synthesize feedback, and partner with go-to-market teams - Be deeply curious, empathetic, and user-centric, with a knack for driving effective collaboration among diverse stakeholders - Communicate with clarity and influence—both written and verbal—with team members, stakeholders, and executives - Have a learner’s mindset, a genuine passion for building AI products, and the grit to experiment, iterate, and fail - Have a deep interest in and knowledge of the evolving AI/ML ecosystem - Be data driven– you lean into qual signals from users and can dig into the quant side to inform roadmap & prioritization - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office - Family planning benefits - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time - 11 company-paid holidays - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. #LI-remote At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.
